name: Momoi Kenta
source: Kimito's childhood friend and neighbour in the dormitory. He assists Kimito in peeping into girls' dreams by collecting information on the cutest girls in the school and aiding Kimito giving them the fragrance bottles, all in exchange for information of what happened in the dreams Kimito ends up seeing.
